summary: Name closed-history behavior, approximate omissions and existing source refusals

replay.detail: No replay, membership or stored identity change in this corrective delta.

schema.detail: No table, index, claim field, generated model or wire shape change.

rules.detail: Source guards and error precedence are unchanged. Existing controls now also pin oversized known-owner detail as 503 versus another person as 404, and invalid-update-withdrawal before requester authorization for an ask; a stranger's actual update remains forbidden.

compatibility.detail: History is a separate client behavior alongside dismissal and withdrawal: attention?history=true and now?history=true without actor or owner_run previously ignored history and returned the open list; they now return only closed source resolutions. Older daemons still return the open list. Attention history rejects actor, owner_run, status, owner, native_only=true and non-resolved state with 422 `validation-failed`; unfiltered Now history rejects status, owner, native_only=true and non-resolved state. Now with actor or owner_run preserves its existing work-filtered open/combined path, including its validation, even when history=true. No in-repository caller currently sends these history reads. omitted_items is approximate, can undercount unbound decoded resources and overcount unclassifiable rows, and is not an exact own-person missing-item count or completeness proof.

downtime.detail: No installation or runtime action. A truthful comment distinguishes existing bounded SQL JSON work from skipped Rust noise-body decoding; the query and indexed plan are unchanged.

manual.detail: Before the widened policy or sender withdrawal is relied on, Operations must name every admitted or eligible receiver and client-serving daemon, installed full source/build and verified schema, source rule and history fold/read availability, including offline/rejoin scope. This PR supplies no qualified host availability or rollout grant. Missing receipt means unknown and use remains unavailable; a known four-host set is not an exhaustive membership inventory.

recovery.detail: Current-head results are preserved separately. Corrected controls require their own hosted qualification; no native acceptance, incident recovery or deployment is inferred.
